text:
alina: Quick sync on rollout list density — compact rows with allocation badges are noisy when teams attach tags and timestamps. want to trim visual weight without hiding data.

matt: The current layout: [version chip] [sparkline scrubber] [3 small alloc badges] [deployed at] [Rollback]. Feels cramped at 1280px and breaks on mobile.

rita: Idea: collapse allocation badges into one summary pill that reads "3 allocations" and expands on hover/focus to show full percentages. keeps row tidy.

sam: Keyboard users need parity: pill should be a real button, Enter toggles expanded region. hover-only won't cut it. include aria-expanded and aria-controls.

noah: Visual accessibility flag: the tiny badge colors (light blue on light grey) are below 4.5:1. Either swap to higher-contrast tokens or add a 1px darker border.

alina: Good catch. Let's pick two alternate tokens: token-a (darker bg) and token-b (white bg + colored text). Noah can recommend which meets contrast at small text.

rita: I put two mockups in the drive: compact (single-line) and relaxed (two-line, timestamp on second line). compact saves vertical space but tooltip for allocations overlaps play scrubber.

matt: z-index issue — scrubber overlays interactive chips on hover. set scrubber z-index lower than interactive controls and ensure pointer-events only when scrubber is active.

sam: Tab order suggestion: version chip -> allocations pill -> scrubber -> revert button. Scrubber should be reachable but not intercept focus unexpectedly.

alina: Copy for revert button: current label "Rollback" is terse. Proposing "Revert to this version" to be explicit for screen reader context.

noah: Modal copy draft: "Revert to this version? This will route traffic away from the current release. Learn more in rollback docs." include link. For sr-only, add an additional sentence about metrics rollback implications.

sam: Modal a11y: role=dialog, aria-modal=true, aria-labelledby points to header, aria-describedby to explanatory paragraph. Focus trap, initial focus on cancel; or deliberate pattern: focus primary only after user reads explanation — maybe focus on cancel first to prevent accidental revert.

rita: Also suggest adding an accessible label on the timeline sparkline: "traffic over time, hover for details" and on version chip: "version v2.3.1, deployed 2 days ago at 14:22 UTC" so VO users get timestamps.

matt: Performance note: collapsing allocations reduces DOM nodes heavily for orgs viewing 200+ versions — wins both rendering and layout thrash.

alina: Action items: rita — final compact & relaxed mocks + expanded state and CSS for pill/button; matt — update prototype z-index and pointer-events; sam — write short a11y snippet for tab order + modal behavior; noah — propose contrast tokens and updated CSS variables; I'll create/update console ticket and attach all assets.

ux-bot: Design sign-off checklist: mocks uploaded, a11y spec, copy finalized, QA plan. Add label before sprint planning. :spiral_note_pad:

sam: Quick CSS examples to include in spec:
```
.alloc-pill { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; padding:6px 10px; border-radius:9999px; background:#e6f2ff; color:#003a66; }
.alloc-pill:focus { outline:3px solid #80b3ff; }
```

rita: I'll also show the pill as a split-button style for cases where teams want to open a detailed breakdown modal.

alina: Thanks team. Target a review on Monday. Drop any urgent copy or contrast swaps here and I'll fold into the ticket.
